hardware_constraint: No physical device, USB, ADB, Fastboot, SSH, network or runtime probes while the Pixel is being flashed. Everything below is verified offline only: unit tests, loopback fakes and the env-gated fixture runtime. Physical iPhone (WDA), Android, AirPlay and Simulator paths are code-reviewed and contract-tested, not hardware-qualified.

capability_gap_table.capability: Session-addressed fresh observation (frame id, time, age, orientation, geometry, app, keyboard, focus)
capability_gap_table.before: runtime.capture writes a PNG; runtime.state has stale width/height for the iPhone; no app/keyboard/focus; no frame id
capability_gap_table.target: runtime.observe on every session transport with explicit unavailable fields

capability_gap_table.capability: screen.* (marks, tap, tree, ocr, wait, diff, export) on a physical USB iPhone
capability_gap_table.before: with_screen routes Android serials and virtual-iphone only; WDA XML is not the UIAutomator format the tree reader takes
capability_gap_table.target: a runtime session ID is a screen device; WDA XML converted to hierarchy nodes with point-to-pixel scaling

capability_gap_table.before: screen.tap compares pixels or element bounds; a rotation reads as a generic mark_stale
capability_gap_table.target: marks carry frame id and size; a changed size answers mark_stale naming the rotation; batches carry the frame they were planned on

capability_gap_table.capability: Ordered tap -> focus -> type without lost characters
capability_gap_table.before: runtime.input text sends at once; fill taps and types through WDA/accessibility; no focus wait
capability_gap_table.target: runtime.actions: per-step results, focus readiness wait with a bounded deadline, applied vs verified status, optional postconditions, no blind replay

capability_gap_table.capability: Gesture contract: atomic timestamped trace vs live stream, multi-contact, pinch
capability_gap_table.before: iPhone USB buffers touch until up (not live); pinch unsupported on USB iPhone and Android runtime; capabilities not reported
capability_gap_table.target: input_capabilities per transport in runtime.state; runtime.gesture traces; two-finger pinch over WDA W3C actions and scrcpy pointer ids

capability_gap_table.before: dimensions() requests /window/size before every tap, touch-down, swipe and fill
capability_gap_table.target: cached point size invalidated by the MJPEG frame size (rotation) and by rotate

capability_gap_table.before: a tesseract process per read, also for an unchanged frame in screen.wait loops
capability_gap_table.target: content-addressed in-process cache (PNG digest + language + invert + region); worker reuse remains a hypothesis
tools/benchmark_agent_loop.py over the fixture runtime, >=100 trials per case, p50/p95, failures kept, hardware matrix pending

capability_gap_table.before: approval dialog for destructive MCP calls only
capability_gap_table.target: handoff.* durable request/status/wait/complete/cancel, desktop banner, fresh observation on resume

capability_gap_table.before: operations take ids; nicknames are display only
capability_gap_table.target: device.resolve: NFC + apostrophe folding, exact first, ambiguity error, never a fuzzy pick
gpx.validate / gpx.preview / gpx.play job with speed, loop, pause, resume, cancel on emulators; other transports answer unsupported
diagnostics.report_draft: issue.md, attachment metadata, redaction receipt, nothing sent

capability_gap_table.capability: Mirror polish: reconnect/ownership, screenshot affordance, states
capability_gap_table.before: notice text and a retry for AirPlay
capability_gap_table.target: explicit waiting-for-person / reconnecting / owner conflict / unsupported / paused / failed states where the backend reports them

acceptance_matrix.case: runtime.observe answers frame id, captured_at, size, orientation and explicit unavailable app/keyboard on the fixture runtime
screen.marks + screen.tap on a session id; tap after rotation answers mark_stale naming the size change and taps nothing
WDA XML becomes hierarchy nodes with scaled pixel bounds, editable/clickable flags and focus
iPhone point size is requested once per geometry epoch; a changed MJPEG frame size or rotate refreshes it; pinch sends two pointer sources
runtime.actions: text after tap waits for focus; focus never appearing fails the step with nothing typed; partial failure lists applied and skipped steps; deadline and cancellation are bounded
OCR cache answers an unchanged frame without a tesseract run and a changed frame with one
benchmark runner writes p50/p95 per case with evidence=fixture and keeps failed trials
handoff request survives a new process, completes only through an explicit person action, resume answers a fresh observation
device.resolve: curly apostrophe and emoji names match exactly; two candidates answer device_ambiguous
gpx.validate rejects external entities and oversized files; preview orders untimed points; play job pauses, resumes, loops and cancels on a fake console
report draft masks secrets and home, lists attachments with digests and a redaction receipt, sends nothing

unverified: Every physical-device path (WDA, scrcpy, AirPlay HID, Simulator companion) until hardware clearance
